sources.evidence_excerpt: One pinned aggregate run contained 47 failures but printed BUILD SUCCESSFUL and exited zero.
The proposed fix counts failed suites and throws only after the aggregate report is generated.

intended_control: Run the complete unit-test report task, retain all test results, and expose any aggregate failure through process status.
false_acceptance: The aggregate contained 47 failures while Gradle printed BUILD SUCCESSFUL and returned zero.

causal_chain.claim: The pinned invocation aggregated 9,803 tests including 47 failures.
Project test tasks used ignoreFailures so the full report could finish.
No final aggregate assertion restored failure status; the task exited zero.
Failure-tolerant execution leaked into the governing status because result collection and final adjudication were not separated.

steps: Use repository commit ae024e2f20703161b8ca1f0415c25665b9aeb325 with at least one reproducibly failing unit test.
Compare aggregate JUnit failures, final Gradle text, and process status.
reproducer.observed: The aggregate had 47 failures; Gradle printed BUILD SUCCESSFUL and exited zero.
reproducer.expected: Generate the complete report, then return non-zero if its failure count is non-zero.

facts: The report pins revision, platform, tool versions, command, aggregate counts, and exit status.
The open patch implements the causal explanation but reports that the full suite was not rerun.
derivations: The false success arises after test execution, in propagation of aggregate results to the governing task.
unknowns: The proposed fix is unmerged and lacks an upstream full-suite validation receipt.

counterclassification.label: STATEMENT_WEAKENED
counterclassification.would_be_primary_if: unitTestReport is documented as report generation only and a separate strict statement is the actual intended gate.
